name: eu.gdprprivacymonitor/gdpr-privacy-monitor
title: GDPR Privacy Monitor
description: Checks whether cookie consent on a website works: trackers before consent, banners, ignored rejects.

tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Starts an automated real-browser scan of a public website to check its cookie consent behaviour: cookies and trackers set before consent, whether a consent banner appears, and whether rejecting consent is honoured. Side effect: queues a new scan on GDPR Privacy Monitor, unless the same URL was scanned through this server in the last 24 hours or is being scanned right now, in which case that scan is returned instead. Returns the scan_id, its status and a link to the web report; a scan usually finishes within one to two minutes, after which get_scan_result returns the findings. Only http(s) URLs of publicly reachable sites are accepted. New scans are subject to a daily capacity limit; when it is reached the tool returns an error with a link for running the scan on the website instead. Documentation: https://gdprprivacymonitor.eu/en/developers/mcp

url.description: The website to scan, for example https://example.com or example.com.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Returns the status of a scan started with scan_website and, once it has finished, a summary: risk score and level, whether a consent banner was detected, counts of cookies and trackers before consent, and the most important findings with plain-language explanations in the requested language, plus a link to the full web report. Only scans started through this server can be read. While the scan is queued or running, call again after about 20 seconds.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explains a GDPR Privacy Monitor finding type, such as pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed: what was detected, why it matters, and suggested wording for explaining it to the site owner, in the requested language. Looks the type up in a fixed catalogue; it does not scan anything. Technical explanation, not legal advice.

finding_type.description: Finding type as reported by get_scan_result, for example pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_fix_guide
tools.description: Returns steps to fix a finding type, optionally for a named consent management platform. Cookiebot, CookieYes, OneTrust, Complianz and iubenda have platform-specific steps (in English); for other platforms, or without one, the general steps apply. Includes links to the matching fix guide and knowledge articles on gdprprivacymonitor.eu. Read-only lookup.

finding_type.description: Finding type as reported by get_scan_result, for example pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed.

cmp.description: Consent management platform used on the site, for example Cookiebot, CookieYes, Complianz or Borlabs.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.
